headline: Doubleview Gold Announces C$3.2 Million Private Placement
summary: Doubleview Gold announced plans to raise up to C$3.2 million through a private placement of shares.
why: Doubleview Gold is a Canadian junior mineral exploration company focused on base and precious metals in British Columbia.

impacts.name: Doubleview Gold Corp
impacts.why: The private placement injects cash for exploration activities but results in equity dilution for existing shareholders.
